name: io.github.faulkj/legion
description: MCP-native LLM councils for debates, juries, blind panels, refinement, and custom deliberation.

environmentVariables.description: Run the installed package over MCP stdio (the binary defaults to HTTP).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Default OpenAI Responses-compatible API root for model files that omit baseUrl.
environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Default provider or gateway key for model files that omit apiKey.
environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Boot without any config/models/*.json. The package ships only key-free examples, which the scanner ignores, so this must stay true until a real model file exists beside the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_NO_MODELS

environmentVariables.description: Optional. A model file's apiKey may be "env:VAR" to read the key from an environment variable named VAR at startup; name those variables here as needed. The bundled gpt example reads this one.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Maximum discussion rounds accepted by a council run.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_ROUNDS

environmentVariables.description: Optional soft cumulative token budget for a council run.
environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Allow callers to define ad-hoc council roles inline.
environmentVariables.name: DYNAMIC_ROLES

environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity. Logs are written to stderr for stdio safety.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
